articles.summary: NextTrip adds four travel advertising sales execs and names Brad Buice CTO as it integrates GoUSA TV and JOURNY to reach 250M viewers in about 80 countries.
articles.title: NextTrip Appoints Travel Technology Veteran Brad Buice as Chief Technology Officer and Expands Global Media Sales Force to Power Next Phase of Global Media-to-Commerce Growth

articles.summary: Fourth-quarter preliminary revenue reached about $1.6M from $1.2M as NextTrip expects $3.7M for fiscal 2026 and builds a content-led travel booking platform.
articles.title: NextTrip Reports Preliminary Fiscal Year 2026 Results, Signaling Emergence of a New Category at the Intersection of Media and Travel
